data.speaker: Guardian
data.text:
Stand where I can see you.
I am Master Cedric Voss. Guardian of this vault. Protector of what should not be left unprotected.
State your business.

choices.text: What are you guarding in there?
Do you know how to break the curse?
I need the Blue Crystal Key.

data.speaker: Guardian
data.text:
The Blue Crystal Key is inside. Also the Ancient Seal of Binding, various confiscated articles, and forty years of accumulated documentation.
Nothing leaves this vault without proper procedure.

data.speaker: Guardian
data.text:
Four keys. Four pedestals. Main hall.
I have known this for some time. I have been waiting for someone capable of retrieving them.
The Blue Crystal Key is inside this vault. I will open it under the correct conditions.

data.speaker: Guardian
data.text:
It is inside. I will open the vault when two conditions are met.
No sooner.

data.speaker: Guardian
data.text:
Two conditions.
First: the Ancient Seal of Binding must be secured here. I sense it loose in the east wing — behind a cracked wall. The Inventor's hammer will get you through.
Second: the Merchant's Ledger must be returned. It is inside the iron box on the table behind me. The Ornate Key opens it — check the west rooms.
Both items. Then the vault opens.

data.speaker: Guardian
data.text:
Vault status: {item_count:item=Ancient Seal|bool:Seal — received/Seal — outstanding} | {item_count:item=Merchant Ledger|bool:Ledger — received/Ledger — outstanding}.
Both required before the vault opens.
Seal: east wing, cracked wall, Inventor's hammer. Ledger: iron box on the table, Ornate Key from the west rooms.

data.speaker: Guardian
data.text:
Ancient Seal — received. Condition one met.
Still outstanding: Merchant's Ledger.
Iron box on the table behind me. Ornate Key opens it — west rooms.

data.speaker: Guardian
data.text:
Merchant's Ledger — received. Condition two met.
Still outstanding: Ancient Seal.
East wing, cracked wall. The Inventor's hammer will break through.

data.speaker: Guardian
data.text:
Ancient Seal. Merchant's Ledger. Both present and accounted for.
Conditions satisfied. Opening the vault.

data.speaker: Guardian
data.text:
The Blue Crystal Key.
The Seal is secured. The Ledger is returned. Order has been maintained.
The blue pedestal is in the main hall. That is where the key goes.
All four together will end the curse. That is the correct procedure.

data.speaker: Guardian
data.text:
Obtained Blue Crystal Key
You now have {keys_collected|round} of 4 Crystal Keys.

data.speaker: Guardian
data.text:
The vault is secure. The Seal is contained.
For eighty years, I have done what I was posted here to do.
